verdict_reason: All four acceptance elements reproduce, but the presentation check had three defects that let a record pass or fail wrongly: a lesson record could not present its own beat-8 id and passed only by relabelling it to product_intro; a malformed presentation declaration (string, or a bare list) slipped past as an undeclared canonical record; a flat presentation_order disagreeing with presentation.order was silently ignored. All three fixed on the branch with four discriminating tests; no existing test removed or relaxed.

acceptance_elements.statement: Causal order and all twelve beat IDs survive.
Reordering is explicit data, not relabelling.
acceptance_elements.note: Before the fix Q11-Q14 failed: relabelling lesson_intro to product_intro was the only way a lesson record could present consequence-first, and malformed or conflicting declarations were silently ignored.

findings.text: check_presentation_order ignored the lesson purpose: a lesson record (beats carry lesson_intro at beat 8, accepted by validate_story) declaring a presentation with its own ids was refused presentation-unknown + presentation-missing + beat-statement-missing; the same record passed only when the presentation and statement rows renamed lesson_intro to product_intro, i.e. relabelling was the way to pass. Verified live on pristine 63fde4473 (probe P2, P3b).

declares_presentation only recognised a dict presentation or a list presentation_order. A presentation given as a bare list (the shape build_manifest accepts) or a presentation_order given as a string was treated as undeclared: the record validated as canonical with no order, view or five-part statement check (probes P5, P6, outcome ok on pristine).
A flat presentation_order disagreeing with presentation.order was silently ignored (block wins, outcome ok on pristine, probe P7), so the record carried two contradictory orders.

fixes.change: validate_story passes its normalised purpose to check_presentation_order(story, purpose=None). A lesson's lesson_intro is judged as product_intro for unknown/duplicate/missing/rewind but kept as its own id; a beat presented under an id other than the one the record's beats carries is refused presentation-relabelled; five-part statements are looked up under the record's own ids. declares_presentation counts any non-None presentation or presentation_order so a wrong-shaped declaration is refused presentation-invalid instead of passing; a bare-list presentation is read as its order. A flat presentation_order beside a presentation block that disagrees is refused presentation-view-mismatch. The 11 deleted lines are replaced signature/condition lines; no validation branch removed.

Four tests appended: lesson consequence-first keeps its beat-8 id; presenting a beat under another id is refused presentation-relabelled; malformed declarations (string presentation, string presentation_order) are refused and a bare-list presentation is held to the statement rule; flat/block order conflict refused. No existing line touched.
